description: nextModeSince(before, after, now) -> modeSince; visibilityBefore/visibilityAfter[i] = effectiveCaptureVisibility(captures[i], no annotation, before | after + modeSince, now). Only -> instant, review -> delayed and a shorter delay while delayed release waiting captures, exactly those at least as old as the new delay; nothing that was public before the switch becomes pending. mode_since is inclusive: a capture at exactly the switch instant ("t") already falls under the new mode.
